title: The LORD Answers Job

questions.question: Then the Lord answered Job out of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:1 (ESV): "Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:"

questions.question: Who is this that darkens counsel by words without what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:2 (ESV): "Who is this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?"

questions.question: Dress for action like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to whom?
questions.explanation: Job 38:3 (ESV): "Dress for action like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to me."

questions.question: Where were you when I laid the foundation of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:4 (ESV): "Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth? Tell me, if you have understanding."

questions.question: When the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:7 (ESV): "when the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?"

questions.question: have you commanded the morning since your days began, and caused the dawn to know its what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:12 (ESV): "Have you commanded the morning since your days began, and caused the dawn to know its place,"

questions.question: Have you entered into the springs of the sea, or walked in the recesses of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:16 (ESV): "Have you entered into the springs of the sea, or walked in the recesses of the deep?"

questions.question: Have the gates of death been revealed to you, or have you seen the gates of what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:17 (ESV): "Have the gates of death been revealed to you, or have you seen the gates of deep darkness?"

questions.question: Where is the way to the dwelling of light, and where is the place of what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:19 (ESV): "Where is the way to the dwelling of light, and where is the place of darkness,"

questions.question: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:22 (ESV): "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,"

questions.question: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loose the cords of what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:31 (ESV): "Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loose the cords of Orion?"

questions.question: Can you lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season, or can you guide the Bear with its what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:32 (ESV): "Can you lead forth the Mazzaroth in their season, or can you guide the Bear with its children?"

questions.question: Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you establish their rule on the what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:33 (ESV): "Do you know the ordinances of the heavens? Can you establish their rule on the earth?"

questions.question: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts or given understanding to the what?
questions.explanation: Job 38:36 (ESV): "Who has put wisdom in the inward parts or given understanding to the mind?"

questions.question: Who provides for the raven its prey, when its young ones cry to whom?
questions.explanation: Job 38:41 (ESV): "Who provides for the raven its prey, when its young ones cry to God for help..."

key_verse_text: Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth? Tell me, if you have understanding.
